# Connecting Podia to your AI tool

Learn how to use Podia MCP to connect Podia to your AI tool

You can connect Podia MCP to any AI tool that supports MCP, including Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Visual Studio Code, and Windsurf.

In this article, we’ll show you how to connect Podia MCP with your AI tools.

# Connecting Podia to Claude

Podia is available as a plugin in Claude’s directory, so you can connect it without adding the MCP server URL yourself.

Here’s how to connect Podia to Claude:

1. [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/urmmlnxv/2802990143/bb25d7862a7c116a8126532714c6/CleanShot+2026-11-11+at+11_01_00%402x.png?expires=1795409100&signature=78d2da5ff890531d7d52d19e2c3e627c20fdba07f189e7a568aae1e5943c08c9&req=dignFMB3nYBbWvMW1HO4zXVKYlx484x%2FoBQzERP3rw59YWyvEt4D4SFl7hdP%0AXaCh%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/urmmlnxv/2802990143/bb25d7862a7c116a8126532714c6/CleanShot+2026-11-11+at+11_01_00%402x.png?expires=1795409100&signature=78d2da5ff890531d7d52d19e2c3e627c20fdba07f189e7a568aae1e5943c08c9&req=dignFMB3nYBbWvMW1HO4zXVKYlx484x%2FoBQzERP3rw59YWyvEt4D4SFl7hdP%0AXaCh%0A)
2. Click **Connect to Claude**.
   ​

   [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/urmmlnxv/2803004888/4556e0874bb79ec8b4a037daa9a5/CleanShot+2026-11-11+at+11_01_00%402x.png?expires=1795409100&signature=9564f45c0b5a231b6b2247cedf234c54552492205de0186db43503f6e7322bf1&req=dignFcl%2BmYlXUfMW1HO4zeUsGUik1qkJAI0FdwXyNDr6C15Gl%2FRSVIqynViN%0Adcdu%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/urmmlnxv/2803004888/4556e0874bb79ec8b4a037daa9a5/CleanShot+2026-11-11+at+11_01_00%402x.png?expires=1795409100&signature=9564f45c0b5a231b6b2247cedf234c54552492205de0186db43503f6e7322bf1&req=dignFcl%2BmYlXUfMW1HO4zeUsGUik1qkJAI0FdwXyNDr6C15Gl%2FRSVIqynViN%0Adcdu%0A)
3. Sign in to your Podia account when prompted.
4. Review the requested permissions, then click **Accept** to authorize the connection.
   ​

   [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/urmmlnxv/2803007573/ed2a26789060697a4fc8e9f5991d/CleanShot+2026-11-11+at+11_06_24%402x.png?expires=1795409100&signature=08837a231ed61eb01378297754c68a67f2f8c1f1656d1fe10c15c91bb7277d27&req=dignFcl%2BmoRYWvMW1HO4zc%2F6tevhTmsx4EPtFyeoC7NrqTkCW6phukjMyYvA%0AaJWQ%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/urmmlnxv/2803007573/ed2a26789060697a4fc8e9f5991d/CleanShot+2026-11-11+at+11_06_24%402x.png?expires=1795409100&signature=08837a231ed61eb01378297754c68a67f2f8c1f1656d1fe10c15c91bb7277d27&req=dignFcl%2BmoRYWvMW1HO4zc%2F6tevhTmsx4EPtFyeoC7NrqTkCW6phukjMyYvA%0AaJWQ%0A)

You can also find Podia inside Claude. Click **Customize** in the sidebar menu, open **Connectors**, search for **Podia**, and click **Connect**.
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/urmmlnxv/2803006910/84eddbada9efb1dd389958c776fb/CleanShot+2026-11-11+at+11_05_33%402x.png?expires=1795409100&signature=50205bacfb4de21c16c4afc3b7de3b98905049881c2c5c21c96ac112e33a8ba0&req=dignFcl%2Bm4heWfMW1HO4zdaHbvulqMKU9VBVoM0yVPvH37g0870pSfhIh4%2F%2B%0AR2OX2dWmNKHFGZ9cJHs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/urmmlnxv/2803006910/84eddbada9efb1dd389958c776fb/CleanShot+2026-11-11+at+11_05_33%402x.png?expires=1795409100&signature=50205bacfb4de21c16c4afc3b7de3b98905049881c2c5c21c96ac112e33a8ba0&req=dignFcl%2Bm4heWfMW1HO4zdaHbvulqMKU9VBVoM0yVPvH37g0870pSfhIh4%2F%2B%0AR2OX2dWmNKHFGZ9cJHs%3D%0A)

If you use Claude through a Team or Enterprise plan, an organization owner may need to add Podia for your team before you can connect it.

# Connecting Podia to ChatGPT

A Podia plugin for ChatGPT is coming soon.

In the meantime, you can connect Podia to ChatGPT by following the steps in **Manually connecting Podia to your AI using the MCP server** below.

# Connecting the MCP via a prompt

One of the easiest ways to connect Podia to an AI tool is by using a prompt. If your AI tool supports adding custom MCP servers through a conversation, ask it to create a connection using Podia’s MCP server URL.

Here’s a prompt you can copy and use:

```
Please help me set up a new custom MCP server using the following endpoint and complete the authorization process: https://app.podia.com/mcp
```

Your AI tool will guide you through the remaining steps, including signing in to Podia and authorizing the connection.

# Manually connecting Podia to your AI using the MCP server

If you’re not using Claude, you can still connect Podia to ChatGPT or any other AI tool that supports custom MCP connectors. You’ll need to add the Podia MCP server URL manually and sign in to your Podia account.

The names of the settings and buttons vary between tools, but the setup generally follows these steps:

1. Open your AI tool’s **Settings** or **Integrations** area.
2. Look for an option to add an **App**, **Connector**, **Custom integration**, or **MCP server**.
3. Create a new connection.
4. Enter a name for the connection, such as **Podia**.
5. If asked to choose a connection type, select **Server URL**, **Custom server**, or the closest available option.
6. Enter the Podia MCP server URL: **`https://app.podia.com/mcp`**
7. If asked to choose an authentication method, select **OAuth**. Podia MCP supports OAuth authentication only. Personal access tokens aren’t supported for MCP connections.
8. Finish creating the connection.
9. Sign in to your Podia account when prompted.
10. Review the requested permissions, then click **Accept** to authorize the connection.

# FAQs

### Is it safe to give an AI tool access to my Podia account?

When you connect an AI tool to Podia, you’ll be asked to choose the access level for different actions:

- **Read-only:** Allows the AI tool to view supported account information, including contacts, products, pages, emails, and other content. It can’t create, edit, or delete anything.
- **Read and write:** Allows the AI tool to view information and create or update supported content in your Podia account.

These permissions apply to every request made through the connection. Even if the AI tool attempts an unexpected action, it can’t access or change anything beyond the permissions you selected in the AI tool.

### Can my AI tool use a different email address from my Podia account?

Yes. The email address you use for an AI tool such as ChatGPT can be different from the one associated with your Podia account.

During the connection process, sign in to the correct Podia account through the authorization window and approve the connection.

### I can’t find where to add Podia in my AI tool... HELP!

In Claude, you can find Podia under **Customize > Connectors**. A Podia plugin for ChatGPT is coming soon, so for now you’ll need to add the Podia MCP server manually.

If you’re using another MCP-compatible AI tool, you may need to add the Podia MCP server manually. Look for settings labeled **Apps**, **Integrations**, **Connectors**, **Developer options**, or **MCP servers**.

The setup process varies by tool, so refer to your AI tool’s help documentation for specific connection instructions.

### I’m having trouble authenticating Podia with my AI tool through an MCP server... HELP!

If the MCP server connection fails or you see a validation error, confirm that you selected **OAuth** as the authentication method.
​

The Podia MCP server doesn’t support personal access tokens for authentication.
